non_production_notice: This proposal records only a whole-product candidate observed in the canonical video. It is not approved AOI metadata and cannot be configured as a runtime metadata path. No R4 approved metadata is created until the owner records every required sign-off field.

review_method.prepared_by: Codex local canonical-media inspection; this is not human owner sign-off
review_method.inspection_scope: Static whole-product shots in the requested 5s-to-21s deployment scope. No handle, strap, logo, hardware, closure, or other component AOI is proposed.
review_method.coordinate_rule: The sole candidate preserves the already human-reviewed R3 polygon unchanged. It is video_normalized against the 1280x720 video content rectangle and not against a player viewport.
review_method.raw_artifact_policy: Temporary inspection frames were used only outside the repository and were not copied to Git, metadata, logs, tests, or a database.
review_method.demo_static_assumptions_policy: aoi-metadata-v2-demo-static-assumptions.json was not copied, promoted, or used as a source for this proposal.

observed_static_intervals.unmapped_portion: [12000, 12958) remains pending because the existing R3 owner sign-off ends at 12000ms and no R4 decision extends it.

observed_static_intervals.layout: 2x2 product grid with a Boston-shaped bag, flap bag, zip pouch, and backpack
observed_static_intervals.reason: The actual video shows four separate products, but no R4 owner record confirms an exact canonical product_id for any of them. No product_id, polygon, or exposure is proposed for this interval.

proposed_exposures.source: The field values below are preserved exactly from the existing R3 human-approved Toni top-left exposure. R3 approval was explicitly limited to the Vision 3-B demo and is not an R4 or production approval.
proposed_exposures.human_check: Confirm the exact catalog product_id, the unchanged [5000,12000) half-open interval, all four polygon points, visible controlled tags, no different-product overlap, and acceptance of the provisional 0.04 normalized margin for the selected R4 scope.
proposed_exposures.overlap_result: The preserved polygon is visually contained in the top-left grid cell. It does not intersect an R4 different-product AOI because no other R4 exposure is proposed; the owner must still accept the physical non-overlap check before approval.

calibration_margin.application: The preserved R3 whole-product polygon is recorded as already including this provisional margin. No component AOI inherits or uses it in R4.
calibration_margin.production_replacement: Replace this provisional value with 1.5 times calibration-error P95, then repeat containment and different-product overlap review before any production approval.

deliberately_unmapped.reason: The first grid remains visually static, but it is outside the existing R3 signed time range and has no R4 owner extension.
One-millisecond guard band around the hard cut observed at approximately 12958.3ms.
Static products are visible, but exact canonical catalog identities are not owner-confirmed.
The moving-model scene begins at approximately 20958.3ms, slightly before the requested 21s boundary. No moving-scene mapping is proposed.

existing_r3_owner_signoff_reference.scope: Vision 3-B demo only; it does not approve R4, the unreviewed static portions, other product candidates, or production calibration.

required_before_approval: Record every selected exposure ID and verify the exact catalog product_id, interval, polygon, component_code, controlled tags, and different-product non-overlap.
Record whether the provisional 0.04 normalized margin is accepted for this scope or replace it with a measured calibration result.
Create an R4 approved metadata file only from the selected whole-product exposures after every field above is present.

promotion_gate: The R4 pending metadata must remain pending_review with no exposures until human owner sign-off is complete.
Do not copy this proposal, any unresolved static region, or the demo-static-assumptions file into an approved metadata revision.
After an approved R4 metadata revision exists, separately rerun the complete Vision 3-B path and its fail-closed cases.
